## Highlights

- New: **light and dark theme**, with an automatic option that follows your system setting. Every page (sidebar, cards, tabs, integration status) is now fully themed instead of dark-mode-only.
- New: **Local Taste Memory**. Mark a playlist as "This got it right" right after generating it. Once enough similar feedback converges around the same genre or mood, you can let it softly influence future generations, an optional toggle in Settings.
- Fixed: playlist tags could be silently lost right after generation, most noticeable when a playlist was saved and reopened quickly. A manual "Regenerate AI tags" button now covers any playlist left untagged.
- A prompt spanning a genre/era range that is meant to stay open-ended (e.g. "the 1970s through modern jazz") is no longer silently narrowed to a single closed decade. Recognized in English, Italian, French, Spanish, German and Portuguese.

## New and improved

- The new Taste Memory review panel in Statistics keeps each entry compact (prompt and tracklist tucked behind a "Details" toggle) and paginates like the Library page instead of growing into one long list.
- A "Regenerate AI tags" button lets you retry AI tag suggestion manually for any draft playlist that ended up without tags.
- Integration status cards (AI provider, YouTube Music, Last.fm) now share one consistent green/red "configured" status language, while keeping each service's own brand icon color.

## Fixes

- A slow AI tagging call during save could make the request look hung; reloading or retrying then created duplicate copies of the same playlist. Tag suggestion now runs in the background instead of blocking the save.
- The favorite (heart) toggle icon was invisible in light mode.
- The "This got it right" / "Give feedback" buttons stayed visible and clickable on old, already-reviewed playlists due to a CSS ordering bug, even though they were only meant to appear right after generating.
- The create-playlist page layout is back to top-aligned after an earlier centering attempt left more empty space on short cards, not less.

## Upgrade notes

- No action required. Existing settings, favorites and playlist data carry over automatically.
